game_title: Off By One Fixer – Moonlit Clearing Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonlit Clearing, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, a new healing herbs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 490 points of healing herbs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 490, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Off By One Fixer
